usage.callShape: GET https://x402stock.xyz/api/v1/snapshot/{TICKER} (e.g. /AAPL), no body, x402 USDC on Base

inputExample._note: ticker is a URL path segment, not a JSON body; this is a GET with no request body

usage.outputShape: body.ticker (string), body.data.change, body.data.change_percent, body.data.day{open,high,low,close,volume,vwap}, body.data.previous_day{...}, body.data.last_minute_bar{...,timestamp}, optionally body.data.last_trade{price,size,...} and body.data.last_quote{bid_price,ask_price,...}, body.source="x402stock", body.as_of (ISO timestamp)
quirks: Ticker is a path segment in the URL (e.g. /snapshot/AAPL), not a query param or body. Substitute the desired symbol.
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402stock.xyz/api/v1/snapshot/{TICKER} with the stock symbol as the final path segment (e.g. AAPL, TSLA). No request body; pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. The response is JSON: read body.data.last_minute_bar.close (or body.data.day.close) for the latest price, body.data.change / body.data.change_percent for the move, and body.data.day / body.data.previous_day for OHLCV. body.as_of gives the data timestamp.
